scenes.say: Are you building for today or maintaining yesterday? Let's break down .NET and its LTS releases.
Modern .NET runs on Windows, Linux, and Mac, and it's open source. The old .NET Framework only works on Windows and is now considered legacy.

scenes.label: LTS
scenes.sub: LTS releases get at least 3 years of fixes
scenes.say: Long-Term Support releases in .NET get at least three years of security and bug fixes.

scenes.title: .NET LTS vs Framework
scenes.say: For example, .NET six is LTS and supported until November twenty twenty-four. .NET Framework four point eight only runs on Windows.

scenes.question: Why pick LTS for production?
scenes.right: It offers stability and long-term security updates.
scenes.say: In interviews, don't say you pick LTS for new features. The real reason is stability and long-term security.
